content:
Twelve South earlier this year launched an all-new Valet accessory, which it describes as a "wireless charging stand and personal catchall."

Now, Twelve South is expanding the Valet lineup with a more compact option that supports MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging at speeds up to 25W.

The original Valet released earlier this year measures 7.5 inches, offering enough room to hold a phone, keys, wallet, glasses, and more. The new version, however, is significantly smaller at 4.25 inches.

Here is Twelve South's description of the premium Valet design:

Designed as a home aesthetic first, and a precision wireless charger second, Valet combines warm materials and modern craftsmanship to create a calmer, more refined form that fits anywhere in the home—from entryway tables to kitchens to nightstands.

In terms of functionality, the smaller Valet packs plenty of power for charging an iPhone. It also includes an extra USB-C port for charging other accessories:

  • Up to 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging
  • Premium Nappa leather catchall
  • Four configurable orientations
  • Interchangeable, detachable leather trim
  • Weighted zinc alloy base with hidden cable management
  • Additional USB-C port for up to 10W wired charging
  • 45W power supply and 1.5m USB-C cable included

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is available for order starting today, priced at $129.99 in three color options. It is not cheap, but it does make a beautiful place to charge your phone while also setting down your glasses, wallet, or keys.
